doc: From old/tests/C/test_nested_finals.c. A completes only when both of its regions rest in a final state. Region Ar2 has no final state of its own (Final2 is inside A12, which has no completion transition), so A never completes. v0.5 ignored regions without a final state (bug B12) and left A on e1.
